Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate — supplier packet information request

Hello Frost Technotics team,

Thank you for your packet for SI-CP-0007 (rev A). Please send the following:

1. 1.cert_scope — the quality-system certificate (standard and scope) showing it covers the process that makes this part.
2. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program procedure and recent audit records.
3. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) procedure and example records.
4. 1.calibration — calibration program and current calibration records for production gauges.
5. 2.pfmea — the current PFMEA for this part.
6. 2.control_plan — the control plan document covering all three CTQs.
7. 2.spc — evidence SPC is in use now on CTQs (charts and reaction plan).
8. 3.inspection_method — the inspection method and equipment used for the CTQ tolerances.
9. 4.method_criteria — the test methods and acceptance criteria documents for the required tests.
10. 4.sample_size — the statistical or standards-based sample-size rationale for the required tests.
11. 5.lot_trace — lot/serial traceability procedure and a sample trace to raw material.
12. 5.nc_segregation — nonconforming material identification and segregation procedure and records.
13. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to the sub-tier supplier.
14. 9.second_source — qualification record for the alternate source, Horizon Labs.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
